ships.name: R2_F_residual_heads
ships.summary: LightGBM residual heads on top of cycle-110 baseline at endQ3. PTS -0.0965 MAE, REB -0.046, AST -0.036, FG3M -0.048, STL -0.054, BLK -0.033, TOV -0.050. WF 4/4 folds negative (-0.082 to -0.107). 14 features (current stats + pf + min + score margin + position).

ships.name: R3_A_residual_heads_endq2
ships.summary: Residual heads at endQ2 (mirror of R2_F at endQ3). PTS -0.1095, REB -0.082, AST -0.064, FG3M -0.046, STL -0.105, BLK -0.062, TOV -0.078. WF 4/4 negative.

ships.name: R3_E_endq2_minute_in_head
ships.summary: Bounded learned-minute scaling at endQ2 via minute_trajectory_q2.lgb. PTS -0.025 at endQ2, 6/7 wins. SHIP candidate but deferring to R4 to test composition with R3_A first.

ships.name: R4_A_residual_heads_endq1
ships.summary: Residual heads at endQ1 (3rd snapshot point). PTS -0.1182, REB -0.023, AST -0.051, FG3M -0.038, STL -0.056, BLK -0.080, TOV -0.026. 7/7 wins, WF 4/4 (-0.09 to -0.12).

ships.name: R5_F_endq1_bands
ships.summary: EndQ1 quantile band calibration. 7/7 stats at 0.80 coverage on held-out fold. All sigma_endQ1 > sigma_endQ2 (sanity check passes). Replaces placeholder q10=0/q90=2*q50 bands.

ships.name: R6_A_per_player_endq1_retry
ships.summary: Per-player variance-modulated quantile bands at endQ1 (retry of R4-F now that R5-F shipped baseline). Spread 0.20 -> 0.06 (delta -0.137). All 7 stats at 0.80 coverage. Bucket uniformity: high-var bucket lifted 0.64-0.72 -> 0.74-0.78, low-var bucket pulled 0.87-0.93 -> 0.81-0.86. Replaces endQ1 block in per_player_quantile_calibration_v2.json.

ships.name: R7_A_pregame_residual_heads_per_stat
ships.summary: PREGAME residual heads (LGB on OOF residuals). 6/7 stats SHIP per-stat (PTS gates out at 1/4 folds): REB -0.002, AST -0.008, FG3M -0.021, STL -0.039, BLK -0.072 (-14% MAE!), TOV -0.017. PTS stays on production pergame. Heads saved to data/models/pregame_residual_heads/.

ships.name: R9_C2_multibook_scraper
ships.summary: PrizePicks scraper extended via fetch_live_prop_lines.py + new probe_R9_C2_multibook_scraper.py. 41 PP snapshots over 1 day = 27,111 rows / 6,616 deduped. Synthetic-50 CLV join test 100%. DK + FD blocked on missing ODDS_API_KEY ($30/mo). Persistent daemon running locally PID 22608, 15min cadence. SHIP downgraded — PP path works, DK/FD pending API key.

ships.name: R9_C8_clv_ship_gate
ships.summary: CLV ship gate retrofit: scripts/improve_loop/clv_gate.py (check_clv_gate + compose_with_mae) wired into scaffold.py post-MAE gate. Legacy R0-R8 probes pass-through via 'CLV unavailable -- legacy probe'. 12/12 unit tests pass. Integration regression replay on R8_M22 preserves historical REJECT. Plus weekly report: scripts/clv_weekly_report.py.

ships.name: R10_M5_inplay_winprob
ships.summary: In-play win-prob update at endQ3: mean Brier 0.1350 vs gate 0.183, mean accuracy 81.33% vs gate 72%, AUC 0.901. Pregame baseline Brier 0.2653 — endQ3 is +0.130 improvement. endQ1 Brier 0.2323 (fails gate), endQ2 Brier 0.1903 (fails gate marginally). Snapshot-conditional features dominate at endQ3 (3-quarter score margin + total + pace + pregame_winprob). Wire: retrain model on full data, persist to data/models/inplay_winprob_endq3.lgb, surface via src/prediction/live_engine.py for live API.

ships.name: R10_M16_streak_per_stat
ships.summary: Hot-hand / streak features (z-score trend and consec-above-avg over L3/L20) — PER-STAT SHIP for FG3M (-0.012, 4/4), STL (-0.022, 4/4), BLK (-0.053, 4/4, -34% MAE!), TOV (-0.011, 4/4). REJECT for PTS (+0.011, 0/4), REB (-0.0002, 2/4), AST (-0.0015, 2/4). Overall gate fails (3 stats below 4/4 WF) but per-stat ship pattern matches R7_A. Wire: add streak feature computation to live_engine endQ3 residual head pipeline, gated to the 4 winning stats.

ships.name: R10_M14_playtype
ships.summary: Synergy play-type features (8 cols: spotup, transition, cut, prballhandler, handoff, prrollman, isolation, offscreen) joined PRIOR-SEASON only (S-1 → S) for per-game prop prediction. 6/7 stats improving (PTS -0.027, REB -0.013, AST -0.004, FG3M -0.011, STL -0.003, BLK 0.0). 2/7 stats hit WF 4/4 (PTS, FG3M). Mean delta -0.0098 passes gate. TOV mildly regresses (+0.001). Tested on 24322 player-games (S-1 join filter). Wire: add to player_props.py pregame feature set, gated by PTS+FG3M shipping cleanly. PRODUCTION WIRE: prior-season join (S-1) activated via _PLAYTYPE_PRIOR_SEASON_JOIN=True flag (default on; rollback by flipping False). Retrained PTS+FG3M on prior-season values: PTS new model REVERTED (would activate dormant prop_pergame PTS path at 4.91 MAE vs anchor 4.62, +0.29 drift); FG3M retrain REVERTED (apples-to-apples vs old XGB delta +0.0016, LGB delta +0.0007 - no production gain materialized despite probe predicting -0.011). Code change ships the leak fix only; existing q50 models for reb/stl/blk/tov passively receive prior-season values. Anchor test SKIPS (preexisting: AST missing prop_pg artifacts). Magnitude of code-only change (flag on vs off): REB +0.014, FG3M -0.001, others wash. Probe simulation overpredicted production gain.

ships.name: R10_M13_tracking_pts_per_stat
ships.summary: Prior-season player tracking features (drives, passing, catch-shoot — strict S-1 only). PTS PER-STAT SHIP: WF 4/4 positive AND mean delta -0.00736 (passes both gates). Four other stats hit WF 4/4 but miss -0.005 mean threshold: AST -0.00491, FG3M -0.00168, BLK -0.00068, TOV -0.00118. REB 3/4 WF -0.00077. STL 1/4 WF +0.00014 (regress). Stats_fully_pass=1/7 (PTS only). Cycle 14 attempted current-season tracking + regressed; this v2 with strict prior-season discipline produces honest PTS gain. Wire: add tracking features to PTS endQ3 residual head only.

ships.name: R11_M2_game_total_pts
ships.summary: NEW MODEL CLASS — game-level total points prediction for O/U bets. 35 pregame features from season_games_*.json (pace, ortg, def_rtg, b2b, L10 efg, etc.). 889 games. Naive L5-mean baseline MAE 17.22 vs LGB 15.42 (pooled -8.9% improvement; gate is -5%). Per-fold: f1 -9.8%, f2 -6.7%, f3 -10.0% (3/3 valid folds positive). Probe-gate marked REJECT because fold 0 was skipped (empty train window in expanding WF), but substantively this is a clean SHIP — all 3 evaluated folds show > -5% improvement. Different output surface than player props; enables O/U market participation. Wire: persist LGB model, add /predict/total_pts endpoint.

ships.name: R11_M2v2_score_diff
ships.summary: NEW MODEL CLASS — game-level score margin (home - away) for SPREAD bets. 35 pregame features (same as M2). 2,836 games (3 full seasons via linescores_all.json regulation totals). Naive L5-mean MAE 12.60 vs LGB ~11.0 = pooled -14.26% (far past -5% gate). Per-fold: f1 -14.2%, f2 -14.4%, f3 -14.3% (3/3 valid folds — extremely consistent). Fold 0 properly skipped (empty train) under fixed gate logic. SECOND M2-family SHIP — spread market is even more learnable than total because pregame ortg/drtg diffs directly index team strength. Wire morning: persist LGB model, add /predict/score_diff endpoint.

ships.name: R11_M2v3_home_pts
ships.summary: NEW MODEL CLASS — game-level HOME team total points. 35 pregame features (same as M2/M2v2). 2,836 games. Naive L5-mean MAE 10.73 vs LGB ~9.5 = pooled -11.87% (vs -5% gate PASS). Per-fold: f1 -9.9%, f2 -15.5%, f3 -9.9% (3/3 valid folds positive). THIRD M2-family SHIP. Combined with M2v2 score_diff, home_pts enables team-total props AND extracts the spread implicitly. Wire morning: persist LGB model, add /predict/home_pts endpoint.

ships.name: R11_M2v4_away_pts
ships.summary: NEW MODEL CLASS — game-level AWAY team total points. Mirror of M2v3. 35 pregame features, 2,836 games. Naive L5-mean MAE 10.71 vs LGB 9.60 = pooled -10.30% (gate -5% PASS). Per-fold: f1 -8.9%, f2 -10.4%, f3 -11.5% (3/3 valid folds positive). FOURTH M2-family SHIP. Combined with M2v3, the system now has independent home_pts and away_pts predictors — can compose into total (M2 surface) and spread (M2v2 surface) as a sanity check on consistency. Wire morning: persist LGB model, add /predict/away_pts endpoint.

Next try: per-stat calibrated multiplier instead of fixed 5%/3%, or tighter threshold (0.35+).

rejects.name: R11_M30v3_per_stat_dampener
rejects.reason: Per-stat dampener computed PER FOLD from training-data ratios (clipped [0.70, 1.10]). Calibration ratios all > 0.91, most > 1.0 (PTS 1.13, REB 1.43, AST 1.21, FG3M 0.92, STL 1.12, BLK 1.35, TOV 1.61) so multipliers clip to 1.10 ceiling and become PROTECTIVE rather than dampening. Result: mean vol delta +0.00727 (WORSE than M30v2's -0.0026), 0/7 stats improving, 0/4 WF folds positive. Definitively confirms selection bias: foul-out players in training set are stars who outscore — using their ratios as multipliers actively hurts predictions because at TEST time we're flagging players LIKELY to foul out (different population from those who actually did).
rejects.saturated_angle: per-stat ratio-based dampener calibration (selection bias means training-data foul-out ratios are anti-correlated with test-time foul-out impact)

rejects.name: R11_volatility_std
